notes.title: Update almost here!!!!!
notes.content:
Hey guys,

I am so sorry about the lack of updates, finally got all my project files recovered. I have been working very hard on this update, and I promise it will be worth the wait. In the meantime if you guys have any ideas please let me know. Im going to hopefully have this new build out to you guys before too long, 

Thanks,
Kyle

notes.title: UPDATE IN THE WORKS
notes.content: After a very long time without a update, there is finally a update getting ready. I'm very excited to get the chance to work on this game again. Around this time next year there will be a oculus port, so if you have a Oculus Quest a version is coming just need to rework alot of the stuff. Meanwhile i am going to be fixing alot of bugs and make the game feel alot smoother and visually appealing.

notes.title: Update v0.5 Released
notes.content:
Patch Notes
_________________

Removed the Christmas theme.

After some feedback about it being hard to reach the fuse. I made the decision to add in teleporting so taking out the fuse and moving around the air conditioner is so much easier.

Added unscrewing to the top.

notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.4 Christmas Update
notes.content:
Changes
_____________

Halloween Theme Removed: All of the assets related to halloween has been removed and removed the fog.

Put snow on the ground. 

Santa Hat Added: Put on the santa hat to change the background music.

Added in physics with the back wall so you cant put any parts through it, player physics coming soon. 

Candy Cane Added: The candy cane doesn't do anything you can just swing it around and have fun with it.

notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.3 Halloween Update
notes.content:
The Halloween update has arrived!!!

Patch notes
--------------------

Made a lifetime stats and level system.
Optimized the game a bunch so it will run alot smoother.
Made where you have to pull fuse now to start taking apart the air conditioner.
Made a return home system, where if you throw a part over the fence it will come back 

Halloween tweaks
------------------------------
Changed background audio to a creepier setting.
Put in fog.
Added in a flashlight so its easier to see, but its not a need.
Added in 2 people staring at you, one in the neighbors window, another peeking around the corner.

If theres any bugs or anything just let me know and i'll get them fixed as quickly as possible.

notes.title: Patch v0.2 Released!!
notes.content:

-----------------------

made beta unscrewing for just the compressor, more coming

Also did a couple more changes that enhanced the user experience

notes.title: UPDATE COMING!!
notes.content: Im sorry for not making a update for a very long time, but i've been very busy and all the features im adding are to buggy for me to want to release. Here in about the end of next friday i plan on releasing the update, its going to be a pretty big update.

notes.title: RELEASED AND READY TO PLAY!!!
notes.content: You can now buy and play the simulator. If you guys want to be apart of a beta that will be held in a couple weeks with some big changes, just email me.
